question.problem:
A test cart moves in a straight line with velocity 
$v(t)=\frac{3}{t},$ where $t$ is measured in seconds and $v$ is measured in feet per second.

Find the average acceleration ${a}_{\text{avg}}$ over the time interval $t\in [1,3].$ Do not round your answer.

${a}_{\text{avg}}=$ 
{{field-1}}
${\text{ft/s}}^{2}$
question.worked_solution:
The average acceleration is the average rate of change of the velocity, so

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{v(3)-v(1)}{3-1} \\  & =\frac{[\frac{3}{3}]-[\frac{3}{1}]}{2} \\  & =\frac{1-3}{2} \\  & =\frac{-2}{2} \\  & =-1\,{\text{ft/s}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the average acceleration is $-1\,{\text{ft/s}}^{2}.$
